Wait, zookeepers work at zoos, right? Their job is to take care of the animals, not people. They feed the animals, maintain their habitats, maybe do some health checks. But children aren't animals in the zoo. So expecting a zookeeper to feed your kids doesn't make sense because that's not part of their job description.

But maybe the user is thinking of a situation where the children are at the zoo, and the zookeeper is supposed to take care of them? But no, typically, parents are responsible for their own children. Usually, zoos have staff for animals, and parents are responsible for their kids.

So, if someone expects a zookeeper to feed their children, that's not part of the zookeeper's duties.
